title: Arnulfo Valenzuela
vital_facts: Born 1959; Mormon Colonies in Chihuahua, Mexico.
Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult.
Missionary to the Mexico Veracruz Mission
Married Silvia Pilar Porras on April 6, 1982, in the Mesa Arizona Temple. Three children
Bachelors from University of Accounting and Administrative Studies, MBA from the American Institute of Business
Worked as a manager and executive for a variety of international businesses, including Sweda, Honeywell and Durman Mexico.
Bishop, Counselor to Stake President, Counselor to Mission President, Area Seventy
First Quorum of the Seventy 2013 - present
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
